doc_styles.Display Name: Cover letter, sans plain left-aligned sender block, one-accent
doc_styles.Keywords: cover letter, sans, one restrained accent colour, plain left-aligned sender block, single column, ats-safe
doc_styles.Best For: Single-column cover letters with a sans face, a plain left-aligned sender block and one restrained accent colour
doc_styles.Checklist: Keep single column;Omit photo;Set the sender block flush left at the top of the page with no header rule;Reserve the accent colour for the sender name and rule, never small print;Emphasize by weight and size, not colour fills;Remove text boxes and icon bars
